ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left figure shows a circle, with four equally spaced marked points on the circumference, respectively in the up, right, down, and left directions, indicating that the original circle is divided into four congruent quarter-circle arcs. The right figure shows these four arcs connected end to end into a four-pointed star shape, with the four pointed points located in the up, right, down, and left directions, and the four curved sides of the star shape composed of these circular arcs. Reasoning: The radius of the original circle is 2, so each arc is a quarter-circle arc with radius 2. According to the construction of the star shape in the figure, the star shape can be regarded as being inside an invisible square with side length 4: each curved side corresponds to a quarter circle of radius 2 cut away from one corner of the square. The area of the invisible square is 4^2 = 16. The four cut-away quarter circles together are exactly a whole circle with radius 2, with area π·2^2 = 4π. Therefore the area of the star shape is 16 - 4π. The area of the original circle is also 4π, so the required ratio is (16 - 4π)/(4π) = (4 - π)/π.

method.method_draft: First read the image: the left diagram shows the original circle divided at four equally spaced points, and the right diagram shows those four quarter-circle arcs reassembled into a four-cusped star with cusps at top, right, bottom, and left. Treat the star as the region left inside an invisible square whose side length is 4: each curved side is a quarter circle of radius 2 centered at one corner of that square, with endpoints at adjacent side midpoints. From the text, use that the original circle has radius 2, so each arc has radius 2. Compute the invisible square area as 4^2 = 16. The four quarter-circles removed from the square have total area equal to one full circle of radius 2, namely 4π. Thus the star area is 16 - 4π. The original circle area is 4π, so the ratio is (16 - 4π)/(4π) = (4 - π)/π.

method.method_draft: First read the image: the four marked endpoints of the arcs become the four tips of the star, forming a diamond-shaped square if connected by straight chords. From the text, each arc is one fourth of a circle of radius 2, so each arc subtends 90°. The chord between adjacent star tips therefore has length 2√2. The straight-edged diamond through the four tips is a square of side 2√2, so its area is 8. Each curved side of the star cuts inward from the corresponding chord, removing a circular segment. One removed segment equals a 90° sector of radius 2 minus the right isosceles triangle formed by the two radii: sector area π, triangle area 2, so segment area π - 2. There are four such segments, so the star area is 8 - 4(π - 2) = 16 - 4π. Divide by the original circle area 4π to get (4 - π)/π.

图像描述：左边图中，一个圆上标出了上、右、下、左四个点，把圆分成四段全等的弧。右边图中，这四段弧被重新连接成一个四角星形，四个黑点是星形的上、右、下、左四个尖端，四条边都是向内凹的圆弧。若把这四个尖端用直线连接，会形成一个菱形状的正方形。

推理：原圆半径为2，被切成四段全等弧，所以每段弧对应90°圆心角。相邻两个星形尖端之间的直线弦长为半径2的90°弦长，即2√2。因此四个尖端连成的正方形边长为2√2，面积为(2√2)^2=8。星形是在这个正方形的基础上，每边被一段向内凹的圆弧削去一个圆弧弓形。每个被削去的弓形面积等于90°扇形面积减去两条半径形成的直角等腰三角形面积。扇形面积为(1/4)π(2^2)=π，三角形面积为(1/2)(2)(2)=2，所以每个弓形面积为π-2。共有4个这样的弓形，所以星形面积为8-4(π-2)=16-4π。原圆面积为π(2^2)=4π，因此所求比值为(16-4π)/(4π)=(4-π)/π。
